reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day, 1 to 14 March 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS day
  FROM range(DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-03-15', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), daily AS (
  -- one row per day the campaign had spend
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.utm_campaign = 'nb_email_marketing_software_2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-14'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(s.clicks, 0) AS clicks
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN daily s ON s.day = d.day

solver.query:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS day FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-03-14', INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(d)
), c AS (
  SELECT a.spend_date AS day, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE cp.utm_campaign = 'nb_email_marketing_software_2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-14'
  GROUP BY a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.day, COALESCE(c.clicks, 0) AS clicks
FROM days d LEFT JOIN c ON c.day = d.day
